description: Neutral MCP server definitions for Agent Kit. All versions pinned. No keys stored - reference env vars by name.

context7.description: Up-to-date code documentation and examples from official sources
context7.notes: API key optional for public docs; required for higher rate limits and private repos. Official Upstash repo: https://github.com/upstash/context7

playwright.description: Browser automation via Playwright - structured accessibility snapshots
playwright.access: full browser control (navigate, click, type, snapshot, evaluate, network)
playwright.notes: Only for repos with a frontend. Browser downloads on first use. Headed by default. Official Microsoft repo: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp

github.description: GitHub API access - read repos, manage issues/PRs, code search
github.access: read-only by default (configure tools in server)
github.notes: Official GitHub repo: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server. Use classic PAT or fine-grained token. Read-only recommended.
